pov.mode: close third, past tense — the series' established voice: the cataloguing narrator (counts things, names places precisely), diegetic documents in italics with their own plain first-person register (the Power Log), emotion through procedure and objects, dry oblique dialogue, PG-13, no modern idiom. READER STANDARD: written for a thirteen-year-old — clean language (no profanity, crude slang or oaths), moral goodness (honest, courageous, loyal, restrained conduct; wrong named as wrong; cruelty never rewarded), violence with cost and no gore, no sexual content.
knowledge_boundary: Cael is nineteen. Millrace the 298th evening (a day south of Lowmarch on the Stair road; the ford with the wheel; the ford-keeper with flour to the elbow; the lean-to that is Oryn's clinic when she is in it); departure dawn the 299th. Twelve fragments. Cash 127 → ~125 (the ford-keeper's night). Vastin's knee day 19 of a month; Brom's shoulder; Lira's arm two-handed a fortnight+; Karis's left hand bound (cut at the reach, the 290th).

ORYN: Tide Path healer; her circuit (seven holds north; Thornwater; the old woman up her ladder); her terms of service (B7: 'lie still when I say'; 'Route's whole. The knee held. Nobody died of three weeks. Spring: bring the map, and lie still when I say.'); she turned north at the fork on the 280th ('the day she has to'); she reads flow/current; the still place = nothing, everything around it; her three readings in the autumn and 'stop'. She does NOT know the leaf. She is NOT a recruit. She counts stops.

THE DEEP READING: Cael lying still on the lean-to's bench; her two fingers on the wrist then the flat hand on the ribs (the ribs 'quiet since the marsh'); the reading takes long; she comes out of it and says the fixed line. Cael, during it, turns the twelfth inward — PRIVATELY — and the still place reads to the Rune sense as something with a lean, a made shape, a stair rather than a river; he has no word; Cleon's warning ('If that fragment ever reads something for you that shouldn't be made … Don't tell me. Don't tell anyone'). He withholds; the two findings disagree; UNRESOLVED (Ch22).

THE LEAF: Oryn is offered the hearing (Karis or Lira) and DEFERS it to the road ('Tell me on the road, if there's road'); she is not told here. SECRET discipline: no Arbiter=apparatus; no Architect present/will; the still place never the Quiet.

TEAGUE'S CREW at Millrace with them (came down from Lowmarch the same day): the tall woman, the broad man, the young one, the healer of no Path (older woman, cloth bag) — the two healers look at each other once; that is the whole exchange. Teague's wrist wrapped.

THE ROUTE: from Millrace the bearing east — five days to the Span (the Stair's bowl, the Hall's marsh, past the fourth) — Ch19 opens AT the Span with the leg logged; the third-tier site past that. Karis's map with the straightedge's line; the blank sheet pinned.
Pike's board: not here. The faceless team: the feeling of being known (Ch17) carried, not staged.

Never 'Halcenvane', 'Velmere', 'Wray', 'Bracken'; no modern idiom; no meta-voice; one-word paragraphs ≤2; 'the way X [verb]' ≤4; 'upside down' 0; capped phrases 0; 'four hundred years' 0 (it was the log's); READER STANDARD.

purpose: Oryn's return and choice — her independent want resolved for this stretch of road, not surrendered. At MILLRACE (the ford with the wheel; the lean-to clinic; the ford-keeper), the 298th evening: Oryn is there by her count, on her terms, and rejoins AS A STOP ON HER ROUTE — she has holds owed a visit; she will walk the bearing-work because it is on the way and because Cael's ribs are still owed a reading; she will turn north the day she has to — and the book makes her state it again so nobody can mistake her. The DEEP READING she has wanted since the autumn: Cael still and whole long enough, Oryn running the Tide reading (current; flow) and getting the still place as NOTHING with everything around it; her finding, unchanged and now certain (fixed line): 'There's a place in you I can't read because it isn't *flow*. I've spent my life reading flow. Whatever that is, it's not the kind of thing my Path was built for.' Privately, Cael has begun turning the twelfth (Rune-adjacent) inward and the still place reads DIFFERENTLY to that instrument — a structure, a lean, something MADE — and he does not tell Oryn (Cleon said tell no one; and he has no words); the two instruments' disagreement stays live and unresolved. She does not know how close she is to the whole reveal; the crew does not tell her the leaf (her choice to hear it or not can be offered and declined — 'Tell me on the road, if there's road'). Oryn reads Vastin's knee (day 19: it held in a cut; 'the month's the month'); Brom's shoulder; Lira's arm; Karis's hand. Teague's healer of no Path and Oryn: two healers, one of them a Path and one not, price each other in a look. Close on IMAGE (card, fixed shape): the two crews and the healer setting out east at dawn (299th), twelve on the road, two of whom will not fight (Oryn; Teague's healer), and a mule; the bearing marked on Karis's map with the straightedge's line; the Span five days out along the bearing, the Court beyond it (UNNAMED still — 'the third-tier site'); Oryn's kit on the mule beside Karis's boxes, a healer's route and a researcher's archive walking the same road for as long as the road runs the same way.

scene_shape.opening_state: Millrace at dusk on the 298th: the wheel heard before the roofs; the ford-keeper counting eleven and a mule; Oryn in the lean-to with a hold-woman's hand between her palms, not looking up, because a healer in the middle of a reading does not look up for a crew — and then looking up, once, and counting them, and finding six, and Vastin's stick.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Cael wants her to have come on her terms and to say them again so that nobody at the ford — Teague least — can take her for a recruit; and he wants the reading, finally, because he has lain still for nobody and owes her that.
scene_shape.opposition: Her route (holds owed a visit); Teague's crew's presence (a healer of no Path already in the party — does the bearing need her?); the reading itself (long; the still place); the twelfth turning inward and finding something it should not; the leaf, which she has not heard.
scene_shape.turn: The deep reading: Oryn's Tide finding, stated as the fixed line; and — under it, unspoken — the twelfth's finding that the still place has a lean, a made shape. Two instruments, one place, two readings. He does not tell her.
scene_shape.choice: He lies still when she says, the whole reading, and does not tell her what the other instrument found — because Cleon said, and because he has no words, and because a healer who has spent her life reading flow is owed her own finding whole and not a rival's laid over it.
scene_shape.outcome: Oryn walks the bearing as a stop on her route; twelve at dawn; the knee 'the month's the month'; the two healers priced in a look; her finding certain and his withheld; the leaf deferred to the road.
scene_shape.closing_state: IMAGE: the two crews and the healer setting out east at dawn on the 299th, twelve on the road, two of whom will not fight, and a mule; the bearing on Karis's map with the straightedge's line; the Span five days out past the Stair and the Hall and the fourth, and the third-tier site beyond it; Oryn's roll on the mule beside Karis's boxes, a healer's route and a researcher's archive walking the same road for as long as the road ran the same way. The file ends on the image — no log, no dialogue.
